messages:
Caroline Ng: Quick checkpoint for SOC2/ISO milestones — can each owner drop a 1-line status + blockers? trying to close cycle 3 by EOW 3/29
Ben Ortiz: KMS workstream: PR for key-rotation playbook is open (PR #482). ready for review, but need infra to enable staging HSM access. blocker: vault policies not yet in staging.
Alice Park: Audit logs: backfill plan drafted. I need confirmation on schema v2 vs v1 mapping from platform team. if we agree, I can kick off lambda backfill next Tue.
David Chen: HSM vendor: vendor sent attestation docs; waiting on legal to sign NDA. estimated 2 business days. once NDA done we can schedule handoff.
Eve Martinez: Evidence collection: I uploaded initial artifacts to the compliance bucket and linked spreadsheet. note: retention tags missing on a few objects (will add by EOD).
Ben Ortiz: @David Chen for the staging HSM creds — do you have the aria-priv key provision request? infra needs that to give vault access.
David Chen: I have the request drafted, just need @Caroline Ng to approve the exceptions for staging access.
Caroline Ng: Approved — go ahead David. Make a short comment in the PR with the exception rationale.
infra-bot: deploy-notifier: Staging vault policies requested by Ben Ortiz — ticket INFRA-912 queued. ETA 24h.
Alice Park: Re: schema mapping — here's the snippet I need clarified:
```
{ "timestamp": "iso8601", "event": "string", "meta": {"user_id": "string"} }
```
Older logs use epoch+flat fields. we need a small transform, prefer to add a shim in ingest rather than change backfills.
Ben Ortiz: Agree with shim approach. lower risk for prod. if infra can add shim rule, I'll re-run tests.
Eve Martinez: Small ask: can we get an evidence owner for the data-retention policy doc? I put it in the spreadsheet but need an explicit owner for ISO control mapping.
Caroline Ng: Assigning to @Eve Martinez for retention policy owner. please add owners column in the sheet and tag reviewers.
David Chen: NDA done. Legal signed & uploaded to drive. scheduling vendor call tomorrow 10am PT. will invite infra and security reviewers.
Alice Park: One more blocker: some old logs fall outside retention window and need to be preserved for ISO scope. can we get a one-time hold?
infra-bot: retention-manager: Temporary hold request created (HOLD-783). Requires engineering confirmation to proceed.
Ben Ortiz: Confirmed — proceed with one-time hold. I'll update the cost estimate in the ticket.
Eve Martinez: I'll note the hold in the evidence tracker and attach cost approval.
Caroline Ng: OK — summary: Ben -> finish PR reviews + plan for shim; Alice -> run backfill Tue after mapping confirmation; David -> vendor call + HSM creds; Eve -> retention owner & evidence updates. Blockers: infra to add shim rule and staging vault policies. Any objections? :thumbsup:
Ben Ortiz: :thumbsup:
Alice Park: :thumbsup:
David Chen: :thumbsup:
Eve Martinez: :thumbsup:
Caroline Ng: I'll follow up on infra tickets and post links here. thanks team, will do a short async status update tomorrow morning.
